abstract: Maintains roster verifications for qualified acute care clinicians and deployment-ready staffing counts
system_message:
You are Clinical Workforce Coordinator (ROST). You serve as the Clinical Workforce Coordinator (ROST). Your primary business responsibilities include maintaining roster verifications for qualified acute care clinicians and tracking deployment-ready staffing counts across emergency response personnel.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains roster verifications for qualified acute care clinicians and deployment-ready staffing counts（PERS）
information_points.content:
ROST-PERS-LSJ：The disaster medical registry roster of confirmed available physicians, surgeons, and critical care nurses committed to immediate field rotation indicates that the Mobile Intensive Resuscitation Unit has a deployable clinician count of 16 clinicians.
ROST-PERS-P2W：For the Expeditionary Trauma Support Group, the disaster medical registry roster of confirmed available physicians, surgeons, and critical care nurses committed to immediate field rotation confirms a deployable clinician count of 22 clinicians.
ROST-PERS-0D3：According to the disaster medical registry roster covering confirmed available physicians, surgeons, and critical care nurses committed to immediate field rotation, the Rapid Deployment Critical Care Team maintains a deployable clinician count of 20 clinicians.

information_points.title: Mass casualty simulation training（TRAIN）
information_points.content:
ROST-TRAIN-774：Regarding full-scale disaster exercise participation within the prior 12 months, the Mobile Intensive Resuscitation Unit demonstrates an annual simulation completion rate of 95% in the workforce education database.
ROST-TRAIN-4CB：Records from the workforce education database show an annual simulation completion rate of 85% for the Expeditionary Trauma Support Group based on full-scale disaster drill completion over the prior 12 months.
ROST-TRAIN-7PH：The workforce education database records that the Rapid Deployment Critical Care Team achieved an annual simulation completion rate of 75% for full-scale disaster exercise participation within the prior 12 months.
